34-2010/2.6/a/two-factor.note: Independence approximated as distinctness of kind. Two factors of one kind do not count as two. `undetermined` means a factor kind is not in the 2.6(a) enumeration and cannot be classified.

34-2010/3.6/d/device-address.note: not_applicable means the issuer holds no address, which the source treats as no breach.

34-2010/3.6/p4/channel.note: not_applicable means no election is on record, so the requirement is not yet fixed.

34-2010/3.6/p5/foreign-deadline.note: `undetermined` means whether the operation was executed abroad was not supplied, so neither the fourth nor the fifth paragraph can be selected.

34-2010/3.6/p4/floor.note: floor_met means every enumerated minimum was met. It does NOT mean the dictamen conforms: `por lo menos` declines to make the list sufficient.

34-2010/3.6/p5/expediente-copy.note: not_applicable means no copy was requested, which is not a breach. `outstanding` means requested, not yet delivered, and the period has not run. `undetermined` means not yet delivered and NO CLOCK was supplied, so late and outstanding cannot be told apart. The 45 day period runs from delivery of the dictamen and is stated as `días naturales`, so A1 does not reach it.

34-2010/3.6/p1/recovery-right.note: Never inferred from 2.6(a) being met. See ambiguity A3.
